messages:
maria: quick copy + a11y pass for the 'Top up credits' modal before billing patch. product wants to reduce support tickets about "will this change my subscription?" and make the CTA wording clear. screenshot attached.
jess: current modal headline is 'Add funds' and body explains credits, but support sees folks thinking it's a recurring upgrade. we should explicitly call out one-off vs recurring and show current balance.
sam: agree. also need to clarify refund / expiration rules in microcopy, but keep the modal uncluttered. link to billing docs is fine for details.
kyle: current primary CTA is 'Add' which is too vague. propose primary 'Top up credits' and secondary 'Upgrade plan' (if they want recurring). include small hint under the CTA: 'One-time top-up, not a subscription change.'
maria: good. product also asked for a small inline info: 'Credits expire after 12 months' if that's the policy. we should surface that as subtle copy not in the main bold line.
billing-bot: policy note: credits expire in 12 months for trial promos, otherwise no expiration. so be careful with blanket statements; use 'some credits may expire — see docs' and link to docs. Also ensure we surface current balance.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) ensure the balance is announced to screen readers on open (aria-live polite), 2) the primary CTA should have an aria-label clarifying it's a one-time top-up vs subscription change, 3) avoid autofocus on the payment input for mobile screen readers, 4) links must have descriptive text (no 'click here').
jess: draft copy proposal: header 'Top up credits' body line 1: 'Add one-time credits to your account balance.' body line 2 (smaller): 'Current balance: $12.34 (USD). One-time top-ups do not change your subscription. Some promotional credits may expire; <link>learn more</link>.' primary button: 'Top up credits' primary aria-label: 'Top up credits (one-time)'. secondary button: 'Upgrade to recurring billing' tertiary: 'Cancel'
sam: also recommend adding an inline note under payment input: 'Payment method will be charged immediately' so users know timing. small copy: 'Charged immediately. Receipt emailed.'
kyle: UX nit: keep the primary button prominent and use a more specific amount placeholder in the input like '$50' rather than generic. add quick presets (25, 50, 100).
a11y-bot: accessibility nit: ensure the preset buttons have accessible names and keyboard focusable. confirm the receipt language is included in the body text and announced via aria-live after success.
maria: final dev-ready snippet for copy (paste into PR):

{"header":"Top up credits","balance_id":"balance-desc","balance":"Current balance: $12.34 (USD)","body":"Add one-time credits to your account balance. One-time top-ups do not change your subscription. Some promotional credits may expire — see billing docs.","payment_hint":"Charged immediately. Receipt will be emailed.","buttons":[{"label":"Cancel"},{"label":"Top up credits","aria_label":"Top up credits (one-time)"},{"label":"Upgrade to recurring billing"}] ,"extras":"Quick amounts: $25 | $50 | $100"}

maria: devs, please wire balance_id to aria-live=\"polite\" region so screen readers announce it on modal open. also add i18n keys: modal.topup.title/body/balance/primary/secondary/receipt_hint. billing-bot: include analytics events billing.topup_shown and billing.topup_confirmed with amount property.
billing-bot: noted. include event property 'one_time': true.
kyle: tiny copy suggestion: change 'One-time top-ups do not change your subscription.' -> 'This is a one-time top-up and will not change your subscription.' slightly clearer.
jess: agree, update that line.
a11y-bot: final check before merge: ensure links have descriptive titles, preset amounts announce on focus, and confirm color contrast of the primary CTA meets WCAG AA.
maria: great, i'll update Figma + open the PR with copy and a11y checklist. if no objections i'll mark resolved after staging checks. :white_check_mark:
